source: Ryansousa10/coa-tier-list · recovered public Phase 1 and Phase 2 specialization candidates
coverage: Deduplicated items appearing in the top-six-per-slot BisBeard candidate snapshots for 70 class/spec profiles; includes dungeon, raid, worldforged, world boss, vendor, reputation, crafted, quest and other recorded sources. This is a candidate catalog, not a complete item database.
dpsMethod: For weapon rows, DPS is estimated from archived candidate score minus recorded weighted stats, divided by the source profile's weaponDps/rangedDps weight. Estimates are available only where the source score and a nonzero weapon DPS weight make reconstruction possible.
